description: Advisory contention tie-breaker only. It does not acquire or enforce locks, uses a post-hoc recomputable SHA-256 draw, and is not host-bias-proof.

agent_a.description: Contender A (used if candidates array omitted).

agent_b.description: Contender B (used if candidates array omitted).

bids.description: Optional finite positive caller-claimed weights for a weighted lottery; no stake custody or settlement occurs.

candidates.description: List of contender agent IDs competing for the lock (2 or more).

client_seed.description: Optional client entropy for a post-hoc recomputable SHA-256 draw; there is no prior commitment or host-bias proof.

client_seeds.description: Optional list or mapping of caller entropy; used as input to a post-hoc recomputable draw.

resource_id.description: Resource lock name, file path, or task identifier.

name: economy_chohan_arbitrate
title: Advisory Cho-Han Contention Tie-Breaker
